---
title: "Tests A–Z"
subtitle: "Every test and method on this site, under the names you'll meet in papers"
toc: false
---

Know the name of the test you need? Find it here and jump straight to its section. Papers often call the same test by different names, so those names get their own rows. Not sure which test fits your question? Start with [Which statistical test should I use?](choose-a-test.qmd)

| Test or method | Use it to | Where |
|------|------|------|
| Aalen-Johansen estimator | Same as the [cumulative incidence](glossary.qmd#cumulative-incidence){.term} | [13 · Competing risks](survival/13-kaplan-meier.qmd#competing-risks) |
| Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment | Adjust many [p-values](glossary.qmd#p-value){.term} while controlling the [false discovery rate](glossary.qmd#false-discovery-rate){.term} | [15 · Adjusting p-values](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#adjusting-p-values) |
| Binomial test | Compare one [proportion](glossary.qmd#proportion){.term} with a [hypothetical value](glossary.qmd#hypothetical-value){.term} | [5 · Binomial test](catalog/05-one-group-vs-hypothetical.qmd#binomial-test) |
| Bland-Altman limits of agreement | See how far apart two measurements of the same thing can be | [17 · Bland-Altman](beyond/17-agreement.qmd#bland-altman) |
| Bonferroni adjustment | Adjust p-values for [several comparisons](glossary.qmd#multiple-comparisons){.term} (Holm's method is better) | [15 · Adjusting p-values](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#adjusting-p-values) |
| Chi-square goodness-of-fit test | Compare one group's mix of [categories](glossary.qmd#categorical-variable){.term} with a hypothetical mix | [5 · Chi-square goodness of fit](catalog/05-one-group-vs-hypothetical.qmd#chi-square-gof) |
| Chi-square test (2 × 2) | Compare a [yes/no outcome](glossary.qmd#binary){.term} between two unpaired groups, in large [samples](glossary.qmd#sample){.term} | [6 · Fisher's exact test and chi-square](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#fisher-chi-square) |
| Chi-square test (3 or more groups) | Compare a categorical [outcome](glossary.qmd#outcome){.term} across three or more unmatched groups | [8 · Chi-square test](catalog/08-three-plus-unmatched.qmd#chi-square) |
| Cochran's Q test | Compare a yes/no outcome across three or more visits or matched conditions | [9 · Cochran's Q](catalog/09-three-plus-matched.qmd#cochran-q) |
| Cohen's kappa | Measure [agreement](glossary.qmd#agreement){.term} on categories between two raters | [17 · Kappa](beyond/17-agreement.qmd#kappa) |
| Conditional proportional hazards regression | Same as [stratified Cox regression](glossary.qmd#stratification){.term} | [7](catalog/07-two-paired-groups.qmd#stratified-cox), [9](catalog/09-three-plus-matched.qmd#stratified-cox), [14 · Stratified Cox](survival/14-cox-regression.qmd#stratified-cox) |
| Conover's test | Compare pairs of visits after a Friedman test | [15 · After Friedman](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-friedman) |
| Contingency coefficients (phi, Cramér's V) | Measure the strength of [association](glossary.qmd#association){.term} between two categorical variables | [10 · Contingency coefficients](catalog/10-association.qmd#contingency-coefficients) |
| Cox proportional hazards regression | Estimate [hazard ratios](glossary.qmd#hazard-ratio){.term} for [time to an event](glossary.qmd#time-to-event){.term}, [adjusted for](glossary.qmd#adjustment){.term} several [factors](glossary.qmd#predictor){.term} | [14 · Cox regression](survival/14-cox-regression.qmd#hazard-ratio); short examples on pages [8](catalog/08-three-plus-unmatched.qmd#cox), [11](catalog/11-predict-from-one.qmd#cox) and [12](catalog/12-predict-from-several.qmd#cox) |
| Cramér's V | See [contingency coefficients](glossary.qmd#contingency-coefficient){.term} | [10 · Contingency coefficients](catalog/10-association.qmd#contingency-coefficients) |
| Cumulative incidence | Estimate the proportion with an [event](glossary.qmd#event){.term} when death can come first ([competing risks](glossary.qmd#competing-risk){.term}) | [13 · Competing risks](survival/13-kaplan-meier.qmd#competing-risks) |
| Dunn's test | Compare pairs of groups after a Kruskal-Wallis test | [15 · After Kruskal-Wallis](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-kruskal-wallis) |
| Estimated marginal means | Report a [model](glossary.qmd#model){.term}'s [mean](glossary.qmd#mean){.term} at each visit or in each group, with its [CI](glossary.qmd#confidence-interval){.term} | [16 · Estimated marginal means](beyond/16-mixed-models.qmd#estimated-marginal-means) |
| Fine-Gray regression | Model the cumulative incidence with several factors (R only) | [14 · Fine-Gray](survival/14-cox-regression.qmd#fine-gray) |
| Fisher's exact test | Compare a yes/no outcome between two unpaired groups | [6 · Fisher's exact test and chi-square](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#fisher-chi-square) |
| Friedman test | Compare a score or [skewed](glossary.qmd#skewed){.term} measurement across three or more visits or matched conditions | [9 · Friedman test](catalog/09-three-plus-matched.qmd#friedman) |
| Games-Howell test | Compare pairs of groups after Welch's ANOVA; it doesn't assume similar spreads | [15 · After ANOVA](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-anova) |
| Gray's test | Compare cumulative incidence curves between groups (R only) | [13 · Competing risks](survival/13-kaplan-meier.qmd#competing-risks) |
| Hazard ratio | What a [Cox model](glossary.qmd#cox-regression){.term} estimates, and why it isn't a [risk ratio](glossary.qmd#risk-ratio){.term} | [14 · The hazard ratio](survival/14-cox-regression.qmd#hazard-ratio) |
| Holm adjustment | Adjust p-values for several comparisons (this site's default) | [15 · Adjusting p-values](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#adjusting-p-values) |
| Intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) | Measure the [reliability](glossary.qmd#reliability){.term} of a measurement between raters or sessions | [17 · The ICC](beyond/17-agreement.qmd#icc) |
| Kaplan-Meier survival curve | Estimate [survivorship](glossary.qmd#survival){.term} over time when [follow-up](glossary.qmd#follow-up){.term} ends at different times | [4 · Kaplan-Meier](catalog/04-describe-one-group.qmd#kaplan-meier), [13 · The Kaplan-Meier curve](survival/13-kaplan-meier.qmd#kaplan-meier) |
| Kruskal-Wallis test | Compare a score or skewed measurement across three or more unmatched groups | [8 · Kruskal-Wallis test](catalog/08-three-plus-unmatched.qmd#kruskal-wallis) |
| Linear mixed model | Analyze scores measured at several visits, including patients who missed some | [16 · Mixed models](beyond/16-mixed-models.qmd#random-intercept) |
| LOESS | See nonparametric regression | [11 · Nonparametric regression](catalog/11-predict-from-one.qmd#nonparametric-regression) |
| Log-rank test | Compare survival curves between groups | [6 · Log-rank test](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#log-rank), [13 · The log-rank test](survival/13-kaplan-meier.qmd#log-rank) |
| Mann-Whitney test | Compare a score or skewed measurement between two unpaired groups | [6 · Mann-Whitney test](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#mann-whitney) |
| Mantel-Cox test | Same as the [log-rank test](glossary.qmd#log-rank-test){.term} | [6 · Log-rank test](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#log-rank) |
| Mantel-Haenszel test (survival) | Same as the log-rank test. The name also covers a test of two categorical variables across strata (a set of 2 × 2 tables, one per stratum), a use not on this site | [6 · Log-rank test](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#log-rank) |
| McNemar's test | Compare a yes/no outcome between two [paired](glossary.qmd#paired){.term} measurements | [7 · McNemar's test](catalog/07-two-paired-groups.qmd#mcnemar) |
| Mean and standard deviation | Describe a roughly [symmetric](glossary.qmd#symmetric){.term} measurement | [4 · Mean and SD](catalog/04-describe-one-group.qmd#mean-sd) |
| Median and interquartile range | Describe a skewed measurement or a score | [4 · Median and IQR](catalog/04-describe-one-group.qmd#median-iqr) |
| Median follow-up (reverse Kaplan-Meier) | Say how long patients were followed | [13 · Follow-up](survival/13-kaplan-meier.qmd#follow-up) |
| Mixed model | See [linear mixed model](glossary.qmd#mixed-model){.term} | [16 · Mixed models](beyond/16-mixed-models.qmd#random-intercept) |
| Multiple linear regression | Predict a measurement from several [variables](glossary.qmd#variable){.term} | [12 · Multiple linear regression](catalog/12-predict-from-several.qmd#multiple-linear-regression) |
| Multiple logistic regression | Predict a yes/no outcome from several variables | [12 · Multiple logistic regression](catalog/12-predict-from-several.qmd#multiple-logistic-regression) |
| Nonlinear regression | Fit a curve, such as a recovery curve, to a measurement | [11 · Nonlinear regression](catalog/11-predict-from-one.qmd#nonlinear-regression), [12 · Multiple nonlinear regression](catalog/12-predict-from-several.qmd#multiple-nonlinear-regression) |
| Nonparametric regression (LOESS, Theil-Sen) | Describe a trend without assuming a straight line or [normal](glossary.qmd#normal-distribution){.term} [residuals](glossary.qmd#residual){.term} | [11 · Nonparametric regression](catalog/11-predict-from-one.qmd#nonparametric-regression) |
| One-sample t test | Compare one group's mean with a hypothetical value | [5 · One-sample t test](catalog/05-one-group-vs-hypothetical.qmd#one-sample-t) |
| One-way ANOVA | Compare a measurement across three or more unmatched groups | [8 · One-way ANOVA](catalog/08-three-plus-unmatched.qmd#one-way-anova) |
| Paired t test | Compare a measurement between two paired measurements, such as before and after surgery | [7 · Paired t test](catalog/07-two-paired-groups.qmd#paired-t), [15 · After repeated-measures ANOVA](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-repeated-measures-anova) |
| Pairwise Fisher's exact tests | Compare pairs of groups after a chi-square test | [15 · After chi-square](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-chi-square) |
| Pairwise log-rank tests | Compare pairs of survival curves after a log-rank test | [15 · After a log-rank test](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-log-rank) |
| Pairwise McNemar tests | Compare pairs of visits after Cochran's Q | [15 · After Cochran's Q](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-cochran-q) |
| Pearson correlation | Measure how closely two measurements follow a straight line | [10 · Pearson correlation](catalog/10-association.qmd#pearson) |
| Phi coefficient | See contingency coefficients | [10 · Contingency coefficients](catalog/10-association.qmd#contingency-coefficients) |
| Proportion with a 95% CI | Describe a yes/no outcome in one group | [4 · Proportion](catalog/04-describe-one-group.qmd#proportion) |
| Proportional hazards check | Check whether a Cox model's hazard ratio stays the same over time | [14 · Proportional hazards](survival/14-cox-regression.qmd#proportional-hazards) |
| Repeated-measures ANOVA | Compare a measurement across three or more visits or matched conditions | [9 · Repeated-measures ANOVA](catalog/09-three-plus-matched.qmd#repeated-measures-anova) |
| Risk ratio | Say how many times as likely a yes/no outcome is in one group as in another | [6 · Fisher's exact test and chi-square](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#fisher-chi-square) |
| Shapiro-Wilk test | Test whether data look normal, and see why not to rely on it | [3 · Shapiro-Wilk](foundations/03-distributions.qmd#shapiro) |
| Sign test | Compare a median with a hypothetical value, or two paired measurements, by counting the values above and below; for clearly skewed or ordinal scores | [5 · Wilcoxon signed-rank test](catalog/05-one-group-vs-hypothetical.qmd#wilcoxon-signed-rank), [7 · Wilcoxon signed-rank test](catalog/07-two-paired-groups.qmd#wilcoxon-signed-rank) |
| Simple linear regression | Predict a measurement from one variable | [11 · Simple linear regression](catalog/11-predict-from-one.qmd#linear-regression) |
| Simple logistic regression | Predict a yes/no outcome from one variable | [11 · Simple logistic regression](catalog/11-predict-from-one.qmd#logistic-regression) |
| Smallest detectable change (SDC) | Find the smallest difference between two readings that is larger than measurement error alone would usually produce | [17 · Bland-Altman](beyond/17-agreement.qmd#bland-altman) |
| Spearman correlation | Measure how closely two scores or skewed measurements rise and fall together | [10 · Spearman correlation](catalog/10-association.qmd#spearman) |
| Standard error of measurement (SEM) | Give the typical size of the error in one reading, in the measurement's own units | [17 · Bland-Altman](beyond/17-agreement.qmd#bland-altman) |
| Standardized mean difference (SMD) | Compare groups' [baseline](glossary.qmd#baseline){.term} characteristics in [Table 1](glossary.qmd#table-1){.term} | [2 · SMDs](foundations/02-demographics.qmd#smd) |
| Stratified Cox regression | Compare survival within [matched](glossary.qmd#matched){.term} sets, or with patients who had both sides done | [7](catalog/07-two-paired-groups.qmd#stratified-cox), [9](catalog/09-three-plus-matched.qmd#stratified-cox), [14 · Stratified Cox](survival/14-cox-regression.qmd#stratified-cox) |
| Student's t test | Like the [unpaired t test](glossary.qmd#t-test){.term}, but assumes [equal spreads](glossary.qmd#equal-variances){.term}; use [Welch's](glossary.qmd#welch-test){.term} instead | [6 · Unpaired t test](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#unpaired-t) |
| Theil-Sen slope | See nonparametric regression | [11 · Nonparametric regression](catalog/11-predict-from-one.qmd#nonparametric-regression) |
| Tukey's HSD | Compare every pair of groups after ANOVA | [15 · After ANOVA](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-anova) |
| Unpaired t test (Welch's) | Compare a measurement between two unpaired groups | [6 · Unpaired t test](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#unpaired-t) |
| Weighted kappa | Measure agreement on [ordered categories](glossary.qmd#ordinal){.term} | [17 · Kappa](beyond/17-agreement.qmd#kappa) |
| Welch's ANOVA | Compare a measurement across three or more unmatched groups without assuming similar spreads (the safe default) | [8 · One-way ANOVA](catalog/08-three-plus-unmatched.qmd#one-way-anova) |
| Welch's t test | Same as the unpaired t test on this site | [6 · Unpaired t test](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#unpaired-t) |
| Wilcoxon rank-sum test | Same as the [Mann-Whitney test](glossary.qmd#mann-whitney-test){.term} | [6 · Mann-Whitney test](catalog/06-two-unpaired-groups.qmd#mann-whitney) |
| Wilcoxon signed-rank test | Compare a score with a hypothetical value, or between two paired measurements | [5 · One group](catalog/05-one-group-vs-hypothetical.qmd#wilcoxon-signed-rank), [7 · Paired](catalog/07-two-paired-groups.qmd#wilcoxon-signed-rank), [15 · After Friedman](beyond/15-post-hoc.qmd#after-friedman) |
